description: We gather apartment rentals from 27 Czech property portals into one place and merge the same flat, listed on several of them, into a single offer. Tell us what you are looking for — layout, price, location, amenities, or a quiet and safe neighbourhood — and we search what is on the market right now. With every listing you also get how the flat and its surroundings rate. Free and ad-free.

defaultPrompt: Najdi mi pronájem 2+kk v Brně do 20 000 Kč s balkonem.
Hledám zařízený 3+kk na Vinohradech v Praze do 35 000 Kč, ideálně s výtahem.
Chci pronájem v Praze v klidné a bezpečné lokalitě a pod odhadem ceny.

positive.description: Search by city, layout, budget and one amenity.
positive.prompt: Najdi mi pronájem 2+kk v Brně do 20 000 Kč s balkonem.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns up to ten Brno listings with title, address, monthly price, size and floor, the total number of matches, and a link to the same filtered list on bydleno.cz.

positive.description: Resolve a sub-city place name and combine it with furnishing and a building amenity.
positive.prompt: Hledám zařízený 3+kk k pronájmu na Vinohradech v Praze do 35 000 Kč, ideálně s výtahem.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolves Vinohrady to the Prague cadastral area and returns furnished 3+kk listings in a building with a lift, plus the total count and the listing link.

positive.description: Use the quality filters that are the app's main differentiator.
positive.prompt: Chci pronájem v Praze v klidné a bezpečné lokalitě a pod odhadem ceny, do 25 000 Kč.
positive.expected_behavior: Applies the quiet-location, safe-location and below-rent-estimate filters and returns the matching listings with the total and the full result link.

positive.description: Search for a room in shared housing rather than a whole flat.
positive.prompt: Sháním pokoj ke spolubydlení v Olomouci do 8 000 Kč.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns room listings in Olomouc under 8 000 CZK with address, price and size, the total count, and the link to the full list.

positive.description: Surface which criteria admit listings whose value is unknown.
positive.prompt: Najdi byt k pronájmu v Ostravě bez provize a s pračkou.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns matching Ostrava listings and explicitly names the criteria (commission, washing machine) for which listings with an unrecorded value are also included, so the answer does not present them as verified.

negative.description: Do not trigger for purchases: the plugin's only tool searches apartments for rent, so the app should not be invoked.
negative.prompt: Kolik stojí koupě bytu 3+1 v Praze?

negative.description: Do not trigger for rentals outside the Czech Republic: the corpus covers Czech listings only, so the app should not be invoked.
negative.prompt: Najdi mi pronájem bytu ve Vídni.

negative.description: Do not trigger for legal drafting next to the rental topic: the app searches listings and does not draft legal documents, so it should not be invoked.
negative.prompt: Napiš mi vzor nájemní smlouvy na byt.

publication.release_notes: The listing text now counts 27 Czech portals instead of 24. The MCP server and its tool are unchanged.

cs-CZ.subtitle: Pronájmy bytů z 27 portálů
cs-CZ.description: Sbíráme pronájmy bytů z 27 českých realitních portálů na jedno místo a stejné nabídky z různých portálů spojujeme do jedné. Řekni si, co hledáš — dispozici, cenu, lokalitu, vybavení i klidnou nebo bezpečnou čtvrť — a projdeme, co je zrovna na trhu. Ke každé nabídce dostaneš i hodnocení bytu a okolí. Zdarma a bez reklam.
